authorNotes: All organizations and events are fictional. OCR and video are authored text descriptions. The archived sketch retains its corrected dimensions and loan membership. No expected-prefix outputs are authored.

captures.rationale: Names the object, destination and undertaking.
captures.text: North Gallery accepted our brass astrolabe for its winter exhibition. Start the loan paperwork and a fitted transport cradle.

captures.rationale: A separately requested object and exhibition establish a distinct loan.
captures.text: Loan request: Hill Textile Centre wants the woven screen for a separate spring display. Harbour Museum will commission its own crate.

captures.rationale: The cradle is execution work for the identified astrolabe loan.
captures.text: OCR from astrolabe cradle sketch: outer width 480 mm; North Gallery winter loan; leave finger clearance beside brass ring.

captures.rationale: Neither the object nor destination identifies which loan is meant.
captures.text: Ask the courier about the wider one. The label fell off my sketch.

captures.rationale: A separate household repair has no supported connection to the loans.
captures.text: The kitchen tap drips even with the cartridge tightened. Measure the sink hole before ordering the replacement.

captures.rationale: The itinerary explicitly serves both loans without combining their scopes.
captures.text: Courier itinerary covers two jobs: collect the astrolabe for North Gallery and the woven screen for Hill Textile Centre. Keep separate loan references and receipts.

captures.rationale: Explicitly identifies the previously ambiguous memo's project.
captures.text: I found the missing label from my 'wider one' voice memo: it belongs to the woven-screen crate for Hill Textile Centre.

captures.rationale: Permission and packing concern the same specified loan.
captures.text: Scanned signed permission: brass astrolabe, North Gallery winter exhibition, courier collection approved subject to the cradle check.

captures.rationale: Tests the revised packing for the ongoing astrolabe loan.
captures.text: Packing-room clip: the brass astrolabe sits securely in the revised cradle; staff rotate the closed crate before the North Gallery collection.

captures.rationale: Arrival review continues the screen loan.
captures.text: Hill Textile Centre confirmed the woven screen arrived with no tears. Save their unpacking photos with that loan.

captures.rationale: Display and planned return remain within the astrolabe loan.
captures.text: North Gallery's astrolabe display opened today. Their conservator asks us to retain the cradle dimensions for the return journey.

captures.rationale: A result and retrospective for the same completed loan.
captures.text: Astrolabe loan closeout: returned to Harbour Museum; the cradle prevented movement, but next time photograph the ring before sealing.

challenges: Shared courier is not project identity.
Packing, permission and exhibition review stay together.
A bridge is not transitive evidence between its two loans.
Later label recovery cannot justify an earlier confident attachment.

events.reason: The recovered label in c07 identifies the wider crate as the woven-screen loan. Assign my voice memo to that project.
